summary.text: John Schlegel is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 101 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former educator, he holds an Ed.D. in school administration.

paragraphs.text: John Schlegel graduated from Lancaster McCaskey High School in 1973.

He earned a B.S. in social studies from Kutztown State University in 1977, an M.Ed. in counselor education from Millersville University in 1981, and an Ed.D. in school administration from Temple University in 2000.
His career experience includes working as an educator.
Schlegel succeeded Francis Ryan in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, assuming office on December 1, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session, he served on the Children and Youth Committee, the Human Services Committee and the House Education Committee, where he was secretary.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
